title: Finite-index Problems in Skew Braces
summary: We investigate finite-index problems in skew braces. For every sub-skew brace \(A\) of a skew brace \(B\), we prove that finite additive index is equivalent to finite multiplicative index; whenever these indices are finite, they coincide. This answers Question~3.7 of \cite{CPV} affirmatively. We then construct a left brace with a strong left ideal of index \(3\) containing no finite-index ideal, giving a negative answer to Question~3.6 of \cite{CPV}.
